reason: The verified GSE99311 continuous perturbation profiles are mm9. Before baseline inference or target inspection, freeze the official Enformer mouse output head and its published global-to-head index offset. The primary zero-shot comparison uses every official mouse H3K27ac target because the official table contains no pancreas H3K27ac or FOXA1 target.
head: mouse
selection_policy: Target rules use official descriptions only and are frozen before any PDAC label, target value, or prediction is inspected. All 107 official mouse H3K27ac targets are averaged; no tissue, cell type, or output is selected using benchmark performance.
unsupported_policy: FOXA1 occupancy is a candidate-only biological diagnostic and cannot enter the Enformer headline comparison. The all-tissue H3K27ac average is reported explicitly as a generic mouse chromatin prior, never as a pancreas-specific Enformer output.
